outputs: Generated text in synthetic decipherment experiment and machine translation tasks.

normalized.translations, summaries, generated descr: Machine translation outputs (sentence translations), Text summarization outputs, Generated text from structured data

changes_made.explanation: Added missing NLG tasks mentioned in the paper (question generation, parsing, tagging) and their corresponding datasets. Removed duplicates and irrelevant items. Normalized model names and task descriptions to be more specific.

Added BLEU metric which is mentioned in the automatic metrics section (though the paper doesn't show BLEU scores in the experiments, it does mention BLEU as an automatic metric used in NLG evaluation).
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper.
No human evaluation of generated outputs was conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on theoretical analysis of causal direction in NLG tasks rather than conducting extensive NLG evaluations. The main experiments involve MDL analysis of translation data and meta-analysis of existing literature. While NLG tasks are discussed, the primary contributions are theoretical insights about causal direction rather than comprehensive NLG system evaluation.
